title: Migrations
explain: A migration is a small, versioned script that changes your database schema. Keeping them in files, in order, lets every developer and server reach the same structure. Tools such as Alembic, Flyway or Prisma Migrate run them for you and record which ones were applied.
exercise: Write a migration that adds a `created_at` column to `users`, and a second one that undoes it.
tip: Never edit a migration that has already run in production. Add a new one so every environment stays in sync.
